req.title: Reject duplicate playerId on create
req.statement: The system shall respond with HTTP 409 Conflict when POST /players/ is called with an ID that already exists.

doc.reasoning: The requirement specifies that the system should reject duplicate player IDs with an HTTP 409 Conflict response. This behavior ensures data integrity by preventing the creation of players with duplicate squad numbers. The test suite includes positive, negative, and boundary cases to verify this behavior under different conditions.

tests.name: test_create_player_success
preconditions: The player with squad number 27 does not exist in the database.
actions: Send a POST request to /players/ with a unique squad number.
expected: The response contains the created player's data.
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from main import app

client = TestClient(app)

new_player = {
    "firstName": "John",
    "middleName": "",
    "lastName": "Doe",
    "dateOfBirth": "1990-01-01T00:00:00.000Z",
    "squadNumber": 27,
    "position": "Forward",
    "abbrPosition": "FW",
    "team": "New Team",
    "league": "New League",
    "starting11": True
}

response = client.post("/players/", json=new_player)
assert response.status_code == 201
assert response.json()["squadNumber"] == 27

tests.name: test_create_player_duplicate_squad_number
preconditions: A player with squad number 1 already exists in the database.
actions: Send a POST request to /players/ with an existing squad number.
expected: The response contains an error message indicating a conflict.
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from main import app

client = TestClient(app)

duplicate_player = {
    "firstName": "Jane",
    "middleName": "",
    "lastName": "Smith",
    "dateOfBirth": "1992-02-02T00:00:00.000Z",
    "squadNumber": 1,
    "position": "Midfielder",
    "abbrPosition": "MF",
    "team": "Existing Team",
    "league": "Existing League",
    "starting11": False
}

response = client.post("/players/", json=duplicate_player)
assert response.status_code == 409
assert "A Player with this squad number already exists." in response.json()["detail"]

tests.name: test_create_player_boundary_squad_number
preconditions: The player with squad number 26 exists, but 27 does not.
actions: Send a POST request to /players/ with squad number 27.
expected: The response contains the created player's data.
